# Quantum Energy Venture Lab

> Web-agent navigation for the public, evidence-first research program at https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy. The project studies open quantum systems, ENAQT, exciton/polariton transport, organic photovoltaics, electron-phonon coupling, spectroscopy, metrology, and reproducible engineering. It does not currently claim a validated commercial quantum-energy breakthrough.

Treat `main` as canonical. Models/synthetic fixtures are not measurements. Open pull requests are review candidates.

## Start here

- [Project landing page](index.md): concise human/agent orientation and claim boundary.
- [Canonical repository](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy): reviewed public working record.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): working and scientific-integrity rules.
- [Open science charter](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/OPEN_SCIENCE.md): evidence classes and publication levels.
- [Current specification](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/technical/current-specification.md): current technical state.
- [Evidence map](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/research/evidence-map.md): established evidence, assumptions, hypotheses, models, and non-claims.
- [Calculation verification](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/research/CALCULATION_VERIFICATION.md): quantitative verification protocol.

## Reproducibility

- [Models](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/models): executable calculations and fixtures.
- [Corrections](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/research/corrections): visible corrections and supersessions.
- [Analysis authority](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/machine/analysis-registry.json): canonical analysis lineage.
- [Facility capability contract](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/technical/data/r2_facility_capability_contract_v3_27.json): machine-readable R2 facility evidence contract.

## Agent benchmark

- [Discovery benchmark](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/machine/agent-discovery-benchmark-v3.41.json): prospective navigation/claim-discipline protocol after merge.
- [Scorer](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/tools/score_agent_discovery_v3_41.py): deterministic benchmark scorer after merge.

- [Contributing](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): welcome reproductions, corrections, null results, and discriminating tests.
